cmd: cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo && git fetch -q origin; for f in pos.py exit_cfg.py chan_orders.py; do echo $f git=$(git show origin/main:bot/positions/$f | md5sum | cut -d' ' -f1) vps=$(md5sum /opt/trading-bot/positions/$f | cut -d' ' -f1); done; git log -1 --format=%h_%cI origin/main; systemctl list-units --type=service --no-pager | grep -E 'chan|pos|acct|tg|class|afd|combo' | awk '{print $1,$3,$4}'; systemctl list-timers --no-pager | grep -E 'pos|chan' | awk '{print $NF}'; (crontab -l 2>/dev/null; ls /etc/cron.d) | grep -i -E 'pos|chan' ; grep -l "exit_cfg\|import pos" /opt/trading-bot/*/*.py /opt/trading-bot/positions/*.py 2>/dev/null | head -20; ls /opt/trading-bot | head -30 | tr '\n' ' ' | LC_ALL=C tr -cd '\11\12\40-\176'
